name: Sondrio (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of light blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sondrio (two swords in saltire and a fleur-de-lis on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Sondrio, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Sondrio arms — two swords in saltire beneath a fleur-de-lis on blue, crowned, within branches
